root_cause_hypothesis: Re-run of the 2026-07-27T16 ENV_FLAKE. That run failed with 8 xppc name-resolution errors (CurrencyCode, CurrencyExchangeRate, CurrencyExchange) because the Contoso sandbox Descriptor did not list the Currency package in ModuleReferences. Adding <d2p1:string>Currency</d2p1:string> to K:AosServicePackagesLocalDirectoryContosoDescriptorContoso.xml fully resolved the blocker: full build of Contoso completed in 11s with 0 errors, no AOS/service restart and no symbol-index rebuild were needed (xppc reads the Descriptor directly at compile time). Implementation re-derived grounded from scratch, not carried over: CurrencyExchangeHelper::newExchangeDate(LedgerRecId, TransDate) + calculateTransactionToAccounting / calculateTransactionToTransaction (crossRate 0 so both legs route through the accounting currency) and CurrencyExchange::round(Amount, CurrencyCode) for the Currency-table rounding rule. All member signatures and arities confirmed via get_method / get_object_info before writing. Writer-shape audit: AxClass element vocabulary of the generated file is identical to standard-model AxClass files (AxClass > Name, SourceCode > Declaration + Methods > Method > Name + Source) and the class round-trips through IMetadataProvider with all three mandated signatures intact, so the golden was frozen. One cosmetic writer quirk noted (see evidence_refs): the source writer re-indents statement lines to a fixed body indent and does not preserve the extra indentation of continuation lines in a multi-line call.
suggested_fix_area: None blocking. Optional hardening: a preflight that derives required Descriptor ModuleReferences from the packages owning the symbols a case names, so a missing reference fails fast instead of surfacing as opaque xppc name-resolution errors (the ENV_FLAKE this run closes). Separately, the X++ source writer could preserve caller-supplied continuation-line indentation instead of flattening it to the body indent.
evidence_refs: writer quirk: continuation lines of calculateTransactionToTransaction(...) written at body indent 8 instead of the supplied 12 — cosmetic, no element loss
